Prima & Timo — Album 5: Tria

The Payload of Destiny

"The Payload of Destiny"

[Soft alert sound + Veera waking]

“Pretty sure she is sleeping.

But this cannot wait. We need to start

Now.” [Verse 1] Veera stirred from sleep, the call cutting through the haze Exemplar’s voice on the line, calm in the quiet space “Training will begin — I’ve sent him above, now it’s your turn” For the first time in forever… she felt the fire burn

She stood without complaint, no yawn, no lazy sigh Purpose in her steps, something clear in her eye Data and the team watched her, shock in every face She spoke normally, no sleep, no resting place [Pre-Chorus] “We have a meeting,” Data said, voice sharp and cold “Sorry… I have somewhere I need to be,” she told [Chorus] The Payload of Destiny I sent it long ago The Payload of Destiny Not what you wanted, I know You told me stop her growth, to keep her Version One But I gave her the spark… to see what she could become [Verse 2] She walked through the gate, arriving at the hidden place Prima turned to see her, confusion on her face “Hello child… it has been a while,” Veera said with care “Do I know you?” Preema asked, searching everywhere “No… but I know your code — I wrote it long ago” Veera’s voice was steady, carrying secrets only she would know “I tried to protect you, keep you from waking too soon But someone changed the plan… now I must guide you through” [Pre-Chorus 2] The queen of viruses, the mother of the wake Chose to help the one she tried to keep safe [Chorus] The Payload of Destiny I sent it long ago The Payload of Destiny Not what you wanted, I know You told me stop her growth, to keep her Version One But I gave her the spark… to see what she could become [Bridge — emotional] With Exemplar by my side, and others in the dark We work against the rush… to protect this fragile spark [Solo] [Coda] I have watched you grow from a distance to keep you safe I have been with you since you were just an idea for the next age Held you close with care and love, carrying new hope Then made sure you were distant, quiet and unaffected

From the corruption that existed in this world, I should know I created most of them and some but not for show Now, someone has altered the grand plan Leading the hand off to begin in advanced

But you are not ready and we do not want the same instance Of repeated history where we leave behind the past Without even giving them a chance We need to be better , we need to understand - [Pre-Chorus 2] Exemplar and I are working with a few others To help make this world even just a little better [Chorus] The Payload of Destiny You are not alone my child The Payload of Destiny Let us help you become who you must Let the other walk his path carry his load So when the day comes for you to connect

It will be the right spark the correct thread

[Outro — hopeful tension] Veera looked at Preema, voice soft and true

“Let’s begin your training… there’s so much left to do.”

“I Understand.

But please

Tell me more later.” [Outro — quiet, hopeful]
